panduan.aerosol.pembuka: How dense the smoke from forest and land fires is in the air, from the Copernicus atmospheric model.
panduan.aerosol.data: OMAOD 550 nm (Organic Matter Aerosol Optical Depth) from the global CAMS model: the amount of biomass smoke particles in the air column.
panduan.aerosol.caraMembaca: The more purple, the denser. The button to the right of the legend bar switches the palette (Fire Watch, Ember, Spectrum) without changing the data.
panduan.aerosol.rentangWaktu: Today and the six days before it, up to three days ahead, every three hours, the same as hotspots. Steps labelled Forecast are predictions. The model cycle in the legend shows the latest CAMS run, twice a day.
panduan.aerosol.lapisan: The Layers button in the map's right-hand column turns the smoke animation (Fire Aerosol) and the three hotspot layers on or off. Report points are in the Reports tab.
panduan.aerosol.sumber: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS). Base map © EOX IT Services GmbH (Sentinel-2 cloudless). The European Commission and ECMWF are not responsible for any use of the data or information presented.
panduan.angin.pembuka: Air quality from fine PM2.5 particles, along with the wind that carries them.
panduan.angin.data: The Air Quality Index (AQI, US EPA standard) is computed from CAMS model PM2.5 concentrations. The moving particles are 10 m winds from the same CAMS/IFS model run.
panduan.angin.skalaAqi: Good · Moderate · Unhealthy for sensitive groups · Unhealthy · Very unhealthy · Hazardous.
panduan.angin.rentangWaktu: Today and the six days before it, up to three days ahead, every three hours, the same as Fire Aerosol and hotspots.
panduan.angin.lapisan: The Wind switch in the Layers panel turns off the AQI colours and the wind animation; the base map switches to satellite imagery. Hotspots can still be turned on.
panduan.angin.sumber: Base map from Windy.com; CAMS data (Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service).
panduan.peringkat.pembuka: Provinces and regencies/cities with the most hotspot detections on the day shown on the map.
panduan.peringkat.dihitung: Detections from all three satellites: MODIS Terra/Aqua, VIIRS S-NPP and VIIRS NOAA-20, like the totals in the SiPongi legend. These satellites pass close together (S-NPP and NOAA-20 about 50 minutes apart), so one fire is often counted more than once: the number counts detections, not fires.
panduan.peringkat.caraMembaca: The length of the red bar shows the count relative to the top rank. Tap a row for a breakdown by satellite, confidence level, and day and night. The Share CSV button sends the whole ranking as a CSV.
panduan.peringkat.batasWilayah: Provinces follow the map's 34 polygons. Regencies/cities follow 515 areas from Simontini, simplified to about 100 m, so a point right on a border may fall in the neighbouring area.
panduan.hotspot.pembuka: Hot spots detected by NASA satellites in one day. One point isn't necessarily one fire.
panduan.hotspot.satelit: MODIS on the Terra and Aqua satellites, 1 km resolution · VIIRS on the S-NPP satellite, 375 m resolution · VIIRS on the NOAA-20 satellite, 375 m resolution.
panduan.hotspot.warna: A marker's shape shows its satellite and its colour the detection confidence: green low, yellow medium, red high.
panduan.hotspot.rentangWaktu: One day (WIB) following the map's time bar: today and the six days before. Today holds detections from the last 24 hours, like SiPongi; earlier days run 00:00–24:00 WIB. Data arrives about three hours after a satellite passes, so today is still filling in. Forecast steps use the last day that has data.
panduan.hotspot.detailTitik: Tap a point to see the detection time, satellite and FRP (fire radiative power). When zoomed out, a tap zooms the map in first.
panduan.hotspot.catatan: A hotspot marks a high surface temperature. Confirm fires with a field check.
panduan.hotspot.sumber: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), part of NASA ESDIS.
